description:
TAG someone who needs to hear this today!

Those who make their lives beautiful, joyful and great really do make it a practice of seeing windows of opportunity where most spot walls of adversity.
 
And once you start operating like this (with the consistency that is the mother of mastery), failure becomes a friend. And a circumstance that introduces you to your gifts, strengths and most high of qualities.

Thank you to each and every one of you good souls who have shown such enthusiasm to read my latest book, “The Wealth Money Can’t Buy”. This guide (based on “The 8 Forms of Wealth model l’ve been teaching to many of the world’s most influential and celebrated leaders for 20+ years), will walk you through an absolutely transformational way to live your richest life (rather than chasing things that only leave you with sadness and regret at the end).

Order it now at TheWealthMoneyCantBuy.com or send me a DM with the words “Real Wealth”. You’ve never read a book like this one.

Love + respect,
Robin
transcript: Hi, it's Robin Sharma, author of The Wealth Money Can't Buy. When I'm working with a client, it could be a professional athlete, it could be a billionaire who wants to bring, let's say, more soul into their life, for example, or scale their fortune even more financially. Often when I challenge them to be a possibilitarian and offer the tools and methodology, they'll say, well, what if I experience failure? And my reply is often, well, what if you experience fortune? And I want you to think about that because fear of failure and laughter and stumbling and things not working out often causes us not even to take the first step that creates the momentum. And as you know, small daily seemingly insignificant steps over time when done consistently lead to stunning results. And so often we won't take the first step because we're afraid of failure. What if I fail? Well, I'm suggesting to you, what if you win?
